text: {"lessons":["My account has grown overall without frequent trading, so I should stay patient and avoid reacting to routine monthly fluctuations.","Selling Stock B at a substantial gain felt rewarding, but I should trim or sell only when it fits my valuation, risk, and portfolio plan—not merely to lock in gains.","I should recognize how loss aversion can make me hold declining positions too long or sell winners too soon; future decisions should follow consistent, forward-looking criteria."]}
